# Categorical Rollup: Agent Skill Evals & Benchmarks

> Comprehensive categorical family index for AI agent skill evaluation, calibration, and benchmarking.

## Family Concept Packs

### 1. Skill Evals Core (`skill-evals`)
Base architecture, trigger calibration, and execution benchmarking overview.
- [llms.txt](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/skill-evals/llms.txt) · [Full Documentation](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/skill-evals/llms-full.txt) · [Compact Rules](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/skill-evals/llms-small.txt) · [Atomic Facts](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/skill-evals/llms-facts.txt) · [Vocabulary](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/skill-evals/llms-vocabulary.txt)

### 2. Trigger Accuracy and Calibration (`trigger-accuracy-and-calibration`)
20-query corpus design (10 pos / 10 neg), activation thresholds (>=90% pos, <=10% false pos), 3-run variance sampling, 60/40 train/val splits.
- [llms.txt](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/trigger-accuracy-and-calibration/llms.txt) · [Full Documentation](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/trigger-accuracy-and-calibration/llms-full.txt) · [Compact Rules](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/trigger-accuracy-and-calibration/llms-small.txt) · [Atomic Facts](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/trigger-accuracy-and-calibration/llms-facts.txt) · [Vocabulary](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/trigger-accuracy-and-calibration/llms-vocabulary.txt)

### 3. Functional Execution Benchmarking (`functional-execution-benchmarking`)
Workspace isolation (`with_skill/` vs `without_skill/`), execution tracing, timing metrics (`timing.json`), token overhead, and quality delta scoring.
- [llms.txt](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/functional-execution-benchmarking/llms.txt) · [Full Documentation](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/functional-execution-benchmarking/llms-full.txt) · [Compact Rules](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/functional-execution-benchmarking/llms-small.txt) · [Atomic Facts](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/functional-execution-benchmarking/llms-facts.txt) · [Vocabulary](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/functional-execution-benchmarking/llms-vocabulary.txt)

### 4. Objective Assertion Engineering (`objective-assertion-engineering`)
Structural assertion design, schema validation, negative bounding checks, deterministic entity checks, and count reconciliation.
- [llms.txt](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/objective-assertion-engineering/llms.txt) · [Full Documentation](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/objective-assertion-engineering/llms-full.txt) · [Compact Rules](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/objective-assertion-engineering/llms-small.txt) · [Atomic Facts](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/objective-assertion-engineering/llms-facts.txt) · [Vocabulary](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/objective-assertion-engineering/llms-vocabulary.txt)

### 5. Eval-Driven Iteration Loop (`eval-driven-iteration-loop`)
Multi-iteration convergence, variance and standard deviation analysis, flaky eval detection, and champion-challenger promotion gating.
- [llms.txt](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/eval-driven-iteration-loop/llms.txt) · [Full Documentation](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/eval-driven-iteration-loop/llms-full.txt) · [Compact Rules](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/eval-driven-iteration-loop/llms-small.txt) · [Atomic Facts](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/eval-driven-iteration-loop/llms-facts.txt) · [Vocabulary](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/eval-driven-iteration-loop/llms-vocabulary.txt)

### 6. Deep Eval Optimization (`deep-eval-optimization`)
12 analytical passes (A–L), prompt realism, discriminative power, answer leakage prevention, fixture integrity, and schema compliance.
- [llms.txt](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/deep-eval-optimization/llms.txt) · [Full Documentation](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/deep-eval-optimization/llms-full.txt) · [Compact Rules](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/deep-eval-optimization/llms-small.txt) · [Atomic Facts](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/deep-eval-optimization/llms-facts.txt) · [Vocabulary](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/deep-eval-optimization/llms-vocabulary.txt)

## Evaluation Tooling & Repositories

- [Evals Harness & Templates](https://github.com/mithudso/evals): Public repository containing test runners, templates, and benchmark reports.
- [Deep Eval Optimizer](file:///Users/mitch/dev/skills/deep-eval-optimizer/SKILL.md): 12-pass convergence loop skill for auditing and generating eval suites.
- [Skill Optimizer](file:///Users/mitch/dev/skills/skill-optimizer/SKILL.md): Skill production quality gate with automatic missing-eval generation.
